ClaudeCodeBot is a macOS app that puts a front desk in front of your local Claude Code agents: a main bot you talk to, one manager per project folder, temporary teams for one-off jobs, routines, and a plugin system the app maintains for itself.

**Install**

1. Download `ClaudeCodeBot-…-macOS.zip` below, unzip it, and drag **ClaudeCodeBot.app** to Applications.
2. The app is not notarized: the first time, right-click it → **Open** → **Open**.
3. You need the [Claude Code](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code) CLI installed and logged in (`claude` on your PATH). Node.js (for plugins with a program part) and git (for the plugin library) are recommended.

See the [README](https://github.com/william1010121/ClaudeCodeBot#readme) for what it does and how it works.
